label: exserted
measures: how far the part stands out of what encloses it

label: fused with
measures: the length over which the parts are joined

label: connate
measures: the length over which like parts are joined

label: adnate
measures: the length over which unlike parts are joined

label: decurrent
measures: how far the base runs down the axis

label: acuminate
measures: the length of the narrowed tip

label: inserted into
measures: the distance of the insertion from the named place
